digest.component_or_area: bridge preview/sync command presentation and reconciler lock bypass
propositions: Canonical preview must render plan and arbitrated field-level drift from a single dry-run pass without launching reconcile-check or acquiring/purging pass locks.
Legacy reconcile-check retains its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair behavior, diagnostic JSON artifact, and lock-free execution unchanged.
Argparse abbreviations and undocumented --dry-run typo must fail with invocation error 2 before any repository access or lock mutation via allow_abbrev=False.
Canonical preview and canonical sync emit identical field-comparable manifest envelopes; legacy uncapped LIVE callers retain historical tally/no-retained-manifest behavior.
Canonical preview reads active local-ticket set once and does not acquire, purge, steal, or write pass lock; collateral repository and ref state remains byte-identical.
Parser level lock bypass for canonical preview route must thread through run_pass and reconcile_once while preserving reconcile-check diagnostic branch and legacy live behavior unchanged.
